canon.note: Skill (140302) refunds +30 Energy per cast. Ultimate Guess Who Lives Here (140303) is a 6-hit Quantum attack. Talent (140304) creates a zone that raises the team's Quantum RES PEN (tri_respen, 0.24); after using Ultimate Tribbie gains an extra 'zone' vulnerability debuff (tri_zone_vuln, 0.30, applied to each enemy). A6 (Gift of the Music Boxes): each time a team member hits an enemy Tribbie regenerates 1.5 Energy per hit. A2 (Summer Blessing): Ultimate raises her Max HP by 990.

fixtures.env: Tribbie E0 solo vs 3 Quantum-weak Elite dummies (Lv120, 6M HP, 300 Toughness), 3 cycles, seed 7

requirements.claim: Basic ATK Hundred Rockets (140301, Quantum) is the kit's Basic and fires in the fixture.
The Skill (140302) consumes 1 SP and is usable without dealing damage to enemies.
Each Skill cast spends 1 SP (4 casts in the fixture).
The Skill refunds +30 Energy per cast (140302 #2); the engine also grants +30 at battle start, so the fixture logs 5 gains of 30 (1 onStart + 4 casts).
Talent zone buff tri_respen grants 0.24 Quantum RES PEN.
The Ultimate Guess Who Lives Here is a 3-hit attack per cast (2 casts x 3 = 6 hits total, engine flattens the triple enemy group to 3 hits per ult).
The Ultimate consumes Energy at cast; the engine logs the spent portion (115.5 of the 120 threshold was available at cast).
After the Ultimate, each enemy gains the zone vulnerability debuff tri_zone_vuln with 0.30 Vulnerability (6 total: 2 ults x 3 enemies).
tri_zone_vuln grants 0.30 vulnerability against the enemies.
A6: each time her attack hits a new enemy target Tribbie regens 1.5 Energy — the engine fires 9 of these in the fixture (3 casts that hit enemies across the run).
A2 (Summer Blessing) raises Max HP by 990 flat.
The Basic ATK Hundred Rockets is a Blast: 1 primary hit plus 2 adjacent hits per cast.
Across the fixture Tribbie regenerates exactly 274 Energy (skill refunds 4x30, A6 9x1.5, Ultimates +5, enemy-turn hits).
When the zone setter attacks alone, each enemy hit after the Ultimate routes through the Zone and fires the additional Zone DMG hit.
Fixture end state: Tribbie damaged to 6806/11000 HP, 94/120 Energy, 0 SP, 2 active buffs (traces + tri_respen).
